recommended_steps.detail: Decide whether the evidence statuses and the limits stated in docs/multi-store.md meet the consumer's need; that judgment is yours.
recommended_steps.title: Judge the evidence contract

recommended_steps.detail: On the clean release commit and qualifying host run ./bin/check all, ./bin/check native and ./bin/check release; a tag needs CHECK RELEASE VERIFIED.
recommended_steps.title: Native qualification before a release

what_just_landed.detail: prepare_search admits one store and makes the entry point's expansion and embedding calls; execute_prepared_search searches the store's current rows with those vectors and never embeds again. The four single-store entry points are exactly these two steps, with unchanged results and refusal texts.
what_just_landed.title: Prepared single-store search

what_just_landed.detail: With evidence on, single- and multi-store searches attach one record per returned hit, read in the retrieval's own snapshot: the stored body, hashes and vector bytes when verified, or a closed status naming what is wrong with that one entry.
what_just_landed.title: Returned-hit evidence

what_just_landed.detail: A hit with a missing row, mismatched body, missing or malformed vector, or missing input digest carries its own status while the other hits and the results themselves are unchanged.
what_just_landed.title: Damaged entries stay isolated
